newsitem.title: INDIA: Separatist militants kill nine people in India.
newsitem.headline: Separatist militants kill nine people in India.

text.p: At least nine people were killed by tribal separatist guerrillas in India's north-eastern state of Assam on Tuesday, the police said.

Separatist Bodo militants gunned down seven people at a local market in Kokrajhar district of Assam, a spokesman for the state police told Reuters. "Senior police officials have rushed to the spot. Details are not yet available," he said.
The guerrillas also shot dead two people near Kokrajhar town, the police said.
Police have launched an operation to search for and flush out militants from the area.
Bodo tribespeople are fighting for a separate homeland within Assam, a campaign that has led to conflict among Assamese, Bengali and Nepal-speaking immigrants in the state.
